tarot.reading: I observe the quiet pattern; the garden has not finished speaking.
I tend growth, water, shade, and the beings who depend on them.
I set boundaries: pots, gates, squirrels, time, and heat.
I honor the old practice, then make it useful.
I choose what I am actually willing to care for.
I move with purpose, but I secure the cargo.
